annotations.title: Read which sections a page's visitors study

description: For a Live Visit Feed site: which sections of one page its visitors study, added up from the stored feed events. Pass `page`, one page's path. Read the limit first: Cromanion stores one feed event per visit, the last one, and its attention table covers one page, the page the visit was on at that event. So the figures come from the visits whose last feed event was on this page. A visit that read the page and then went to another one is not counted, and the figures do not describe everyone who saw the page. Per section: the visits whose event lists it, the total and the median seconds it was on screen, the visits per engagement grade (studied, read, skimmed) and the returns. Under 30 visits the answer gives the count, says `enough: false` and withholds the sections. `visitor_kind` is `human` (the default) or `ai_agent`; the two are never added together. The window is the last 7 days unless you pass `since` and `until`, at most 30 days back, read on the visit's start. A visit judged a bot when it ended, a visit marked as the site's own, and a visit with no stored feed event (a bounce, or a visit made while the feed was off) are not counted. `page` is matched as the events write it: without query or trailing slash, with an email or a token segment replaced, a numeric id kept; no wildcard. It needs an API key from the developer console and the feed turned on for the site; a conversion site's credential is refused with not_feed_site. 60 calls an hour per key, shared with get_visit and list_agent_visits; every call is on the developer's record before it runs.

page.description: One page's path, starting with `/`, e.g. /products/the-edge. No host. Matched exactly: no character is a wildcard.

since.description: ISO date. Default: 7 days before `until`. At most 30 days back.

visitor_kind.description: People (default) or AI agents. Never both in one answer.

name: get_page_attention

enough.description: false: `sections` is null and `note` says why.

min_visits.description: Under this many visits the sections are withheld.

page.description: The path that was matched, as the events write it.

sections.description: Most-seen first, 30 at most. Each: section, visits, total_seconds, median_seconds, engagement `{studied, read, skimmed}` (visits per grade), returns. Null under `min_visits` visits.

sections_total.description: Distinct sections before the cut at 30. Null when the sections are withheld.

visits.description: Visits in the window whose LAST feed event was on this page. The figures rest on these and no others.

window.description: `{ since, until }` as applied, on the visit's start.
